**Finding: compliant** (rule MINCOMMIT)

The agreement contains no take-or-pay exposure for Bluefly:

- **§ 4.1 Charges** — charges are one-time, installment, recurring or usage-based, specified per Service Option Attachment/Order Form; fees attach to ordered/consumed Services only.
- No "minimum", "commit", "shortfall" or committed-volume language appears anywhere in the document.
- **§ 11.5 Capacity Planning** allocates sizing/change-request responsibility to Customer but imposes no purchase commitment or usage cap; **§ 14.11** is a resale restriction, not a volume cap.
- **§ 3.4** gives Customer a monthly termination-for-convenience right on one month's notice, so even any Order Form commitment is exitable.

This meets the preferred position, so no redline was proposed. One point noted for the termination workstream only (not a deviation here): § 3.4(b) preserves early termination charges "specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments" — worth confirming those attachments do not smuggle in a commitment-style exit fee.
